reason: I want to start building the layered skin model; connective fibers and support cells seem likely to form its supporting tissue.
expectation: I expect a supportive skin layer, though I’m unsure how the cells and fibers will be arranged.

alternatives.reason: Joining surface cells also seems useful for making the skin’s boundary, but I chose to start with support.

effect: The supporting layer includes material outside cells, so I’ll build the surface layer next.
reaction: The distinction between cells and their supporting material is interesting.
reason: Joining surface cells seems like the next step toward a layered skin boundary.
expectation: I expect a connected sheet of surface cells, though I’m unsure whether it will be a complete barrier.

alternatives.reason: Connecting the arm to its supply network seems useful, but the current goal is to build skin.

effect: The joined cells form a continuous sheet, so I’ll strengthen that surface next.
reaction: The explanation makes the junctions’ purpose clear.
reason: Adding the tough outer layer seems useful for making the skin resist wear.
expectation: I expect a tougher surface layer, though I’m unsure whether it will complete the skin model.

alternatives.reason: Connecting the arm to its supply network also seems useful, but I want to finish building the skin first.

effect: The surface barrier is complete, and I understand that living cells deeper down replace its worn outer cells. I’ll join it to the supporting layer.
reaction: The replacement of nonliving outer cells is an interesting detail.
reason: Combining the barrier with its supporting layer should form the layered skin model.
expectation: I expect a layered skin model with a protective surface and deeper support.

alternatives.reason: The arm also needs its supply network, but the skin goal is still underway.

effect: The barrier and supporting layer now form layered skin; I’ll add sensation next.
reaction: The layers’ different roles fit together clearly.
reason: Adding sensory endings should let the skin detect contact.
expectation: I expect skin that can sense touch, though I’m unsure how it will connect to the arm.

alternatives.reason: Connecting the arm to its supply network also seems useful, but I want to finish the skin first.

effect: The skin now provides sensory information as well as protection, and the new goal is to join it with supply and control.
reaction: Connecting touch to the skin's protective role makes the model more useful.
reason: Connecting the arm to the supply network is the only offered combination and should advance the new goal.
expectation: I expect an arm connected to oxygen and nutrient supplies, with skin still to be added.

effect: The arm now has a supply route as well as nerve control, so I can add the skin.
reaction: The distinction between supplying and directing the muscles is clear.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should join the skin to the supplied arm.
expectation: I expect a protected, sensitive arm with its supply and control systems connected.

effect: The arm, skin, control and supply routes now form a living body model, and the goal is to use it to lift and hold the glass.
reaction: Bringing the systems together makes their cooperation clearer.
reason: The glass and body model are the only offered combination and should advance the new goal.
expectation: I expect the model to lift and hold the glass, showing how its tissues work together.

effect: Holding the glass brings the systems together and shows that muscles, nerves, circulation and skin continue working even when the arm is still.
reaction: The contrast between a still glass and the ongoing work inside the body was satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Lifting and holding the glass was most worthwhile because it gave the assembled systems a shared, recognizable task.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two skin layers felt predictable after making them, although it clearly showed their different roles.

surprise.text: I found it interesting that the outermost skin cells are no longer living and are continually replaced by deeper living cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the offered combinations had clear purposes, though the later choices were mostly the only combinations available.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it offered a new body task or relationship to explore; assembling the skin was clear, but the sequence became predictable.
